# Code of Conduct

Be respectful, assume good faith, criticize ideas with evidence, and give people room to learn.
Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, sustained disruption, publishing private
information, and sexualized attention are not accepted.

Compatibility findings can affect vendors and other projects. Describe observations factually,
include reproducible conditions, disclose relevant relationships, and correct mistakes openly.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, reject contributions, or restrict participation to protect
the community. Use GitHub's reporting tools for platform abuse and avoid putting sensitive conduct
reports in public issues.
